# Requirements — Styled Ranges in Text Elements (Colour + Highlight)

- **Run ID:** `20261105-105313-feature-new-text-range-styles`
- **Mode:** `brownfield`
- **Intent:** `feature-new`
- **Policy:** `argon4-agsdk-only`
- **Auth mode:** `vendor`
- **Test command:** `yarn test:typecheck && yarn test:code && yarn test:app --watch=false` (from repo root)

---

## Explicit Assumptions & Gate 0 Decisions

1. **Gate 0 — Concurrent edit resolution (frozen):** Concurrent edits to the same text element by multiple collaborators retain today's whole-element last-writer-wins reconciliation (`highest version wins`, discarding remote updates to an actively edited element). `packages/excalidraw/data/reconcile.ts` and `packages/element/src/delta.ts` are strictly off-limits.
2. **Gate 0 — Write contract (frozen):** Only the 32 allowlist entries in the brief's *Files in scope* may be created or modified; all 30 patterns in *Files off-limits* (including `excalidraw-app/**`, `packages/excalidraw/components/App.tsx`, `packages/excalidraw/data/reconcile.ts`, `packages/element/src/delta.ts`, non-English locale files, and AI/agent config files) must remain untouched.
3. **Gate 0 — Absent-when-empty representation:** When a text element has no styled ranges (or all ranges have been cleared/deleted), the new field on `ExcalidrawTextElement` is omitted (`undefined`) or kept absent rather than materialised as `[]`, so unstyled text elements remain byte-identical in JSON/memory to today's elements and existing snapshot files (`history.test.tsx.snap`, `regressionTests.test.tsx.snap`, `restore.test.ts.snap`, `export.test.ts.snap`) do not require regeneration unless required by a specific architectural choice.
4. **Assumption — Typing at range boundaries (extend rule):** When text is inserted strictly before a range (`pos <= range.start`), the range shifts right by the inserted length; when inserted strictly inside a range (`range.start < pos < range.end`), the range expands by the inserted length

Phase 1 (`requirements_analysis`) is complete. The requirements specification has been written to `.sdlc/runs/20261105-105313-feature-new-text-range-styles/requirements.md` covering:

- **Explicit Assumptions & Gate 0 Decisions**: Whole-element last-writer-wins reconciliation (`reconcile.ts` and `delta.ts` off-limits), frozen write contract, absent-when-empty field representation to preserve existing snapshots, range boundary extension rules, and UTF-16 code-unit indexing against `originalText`.
- **In scope (`IS-1`–`IS-8`) & Out of scope (`OOS-1`–`OOS-8`)**: Numbered, testable boundaries aligned with the approved intent brief.
- **Functional requirements per module (`FR-1`–`FR-16`)**: Traceable requirements across `packages/element` (`types.ts`, `textStyles.ts`, `index.ts`, `newElement.ts`, `textElement.ts`, `listMarker.ts`, `renderElement.ts`) and `packages/excalidraw` (`textWysiwyg.tsx`, `App.text.ts`, `App.duplicate.ts`, `actionProperties.tsx`, `Actions.tsx`, `en.json`, `restore.ts`, `staticSvgScene.ts`, `CHANGELOG.md`).
- **Non-functional requirements (`NFR-1`–`NFR-5`)**: Zero regression for unstyled text, immutable updates for history delta tracking, performance fast-paths, repo convention compliance, and restore sanitization.
- **PII inventory & Role matrix**: Client-side data sensitivity and editor/collaborator/view-mode permission matrix.
- **Acceptance criteria (`AC-1`–`AC-6`)**: Executable unit, jsdom integration, restore/reconcile, SVG export, and full suite (`yarn test:typecheck && yarn test:code && yarn test:app --watch=false`) verification criteria.
